86867067.title: Midnight_Sun_(Zara_Larsson_album)
86867067.extract:
### Background
Larsson's previous album, Venus, was released in February 2024. Following its release, she expressed interest in exploring themes tied to her Swedish heritage for her next project. In interviews, Larsson described Midnight Sun as capturing the essence of a Swedish summer, where the sun remains visible late into the night, evoking both joyful and melancholic memories. She stated that the album reflects a personal connection to Scandinavian culture and represents a period of self-discovery in her late twenties.

The album was initially considered for the title Puss Puss, which later became the name of its closing track. Larsson established her own label, Sommer House, in 2023, and Midnight Sun marks her first release under this imprint alongside Epic Records.

### Recording and production
Recording for Midnight Sun took place between 2024 and 2025. Larsson worked with a core team of collaborators, including British producer MNEK, who served as executive producer, and producers Margo XS and Zhone. Songwriter Helena Gao contributed to multiple tracks. Additional personnel included engineers such as Kaelen Russel and mixer Tom Norris.

Larsson aimed for a cohesive sound that blended dance-pop with electropop influences, emphasizing high-energy production. She noted that the process encouraged her to be more expressive in her songwriting and collaboration. Tracks were recorded in various locations, though specific studios were not publicly detailed.

### Music and lyrics
Midnight Sun spans 10 tracks with a total runtime of 31:54. The album explores themes of love, self-empowerment, ambition, and personal growth, often framed through the metaphor of endless summer nights.

The opening title track "Midnight Sun" is an electropop song about embracing eternal light and freedom. "Blue Moon" follows with upbeat rhythms addressing fleeting emotions. "Pretty Ugly" introduces chaotic energy with punk-inspired elements, discussing contradictions in relationships. "Girl's Girl" and "Crush" focus on attraction and confidence, featuring pulsating beats.

Mid-album tracks like "Eurosummer" and "Hot & Sexy" incorporate rave and dance influences, with lyrics on seasonal romance and sensuality. "The Ambition" reflects on career pressures and the need for validation. "Saturn's Return" addresses the challenges of maturation in one's late twenties, with vulnerable lyrics such as "It feels so good to know that I don’t know what I’m doing. I love that I’m free in my naivety." The album closes with "Puss Puss", a dismissive take on romance.

### Release and promotion
Midnight Sun was announced in June 2025, with the tracklist revealed in September. It was released on 26 September 2025 in digital, CD, and vinyl formats, including limited editions such as a clear vinyl and a Lisa Frank-themed CD. A Dolby Atmos mix was also made available.

Promotion included the release of three singles. "Pretty Ugly" was issued on 25 April 2025 as the lead single. The title track followed on 13 June 2025. "Crush" served as the third single on 15 August 2025. Music videos accompanied each single.

Larsson announced the Midnight Sun Tour on 2 September 2025. The tour commenced on 28 October 2025 in Munich, Germany, with European dates concluding in November 2025. A North American leg began on 28 February 2026 in Portland, Oregon, and ended on 12 April 2026 in Houston, Texas, with support from Amelia Moore. The tour included over 30 dates across Europe and North America.

### Critical reception
Midnight Sun received generally positive reviews. At Metacritic, which assigns a normalized rating out of 100 to reviews from professional publications, the album received an average score of 89 based on four reviews, indicating "universal acclaim". Aggregator AnyDecentMusic? gave it 8.0 out of 10, based on their assessment of the critical consensus. Album of the Year compiled a critic score of 80 based on seven reviews.

DIY praised the album's "forward-thinking, lush alive-ness" and variations in electronica, dance, Scandi-pop, and R&B. AllMusic described it as a "catalog highlight" for its brevity and blend of honesty with pop elements. Rolling Stone noted its "high-energy dance-pop joy" that refuses to slow down. Clash highlighted Larsson's focus on "starry-eyed, joyous Scandi-pop". Dork commended the album for allowing Larsson to embrace her personality beyond polished radio pop. God Is in the TV suggested Larsson deserves broader recognition comparable to major artists. However, Spectrum Culture criticized it as a "sultry summer pop album" released too late, claiming it "misses every shot".

User reception was mixed but leaned positive, with an average score of 73 on Album of the Year based on over 3,000 ratings.

### Commercial performance
Midnight Sun debuted at number one on the Swedish Albums Chart, marking Larsson's third number-one album in her home country. It remained in the top five for three weeks.

In the United Kingdom, the album entered the UK Albums Chart at number 36. In the United States, it debuted at number 119 on the Billboard 200 with 11,000 album-equivalent units in its first week. It also reached number three on the Billboard Top Dance/Electronic Albums chart, a career high for Larsson.

The album charted in 13 territories overall, including top-10 positions in several European markets. First-week global streams exceeded 3.8 million on Spotify.

Larsson collaborated with producers such as MNEK, Margo XS, and Zhone, and songwriter Helena Gao on the project. Midnight Sun received generally positive reviews from critics and debuted at number one on the Swedish Albums Chart. It also charted within the top 40 in the United Kingdom and entered the US Billboard 200.

The album was supported by three singles: "Pretty Ugly", released in April 2025; the title track "Midnight Sun", released in June; and "Crush", released in August. To promote the album, Larsson embarked on the Midnight Sun Tour, which began in October 2025.

She stated that the album reflects a personal connection to Scandinavian culture and represents a period of self-discovery in her late twenties. Larsson has said: "I really am proud of my Swedish pop heritage, so I wanted to write about a Swedish summer where the sun never goes down. I wanted the whole album to feel like it’s a summer night and it never ends. And it doesn’t matter if it’s December: the summer night will be there for you. It’s waiting for you, it will come back for you, and you will come back for it. Throughout Midnight Sun, I get to just capture that total Scandinavian vibe, which is something that I have grown up with—it’s a huge part of me, my happiest memories and my saddest ones, too. A part of my soul is a Swedish summer night. This record encompasses that, how life is so beautiful it makes you cry. It just feels like me—knowing myself, this album is just really, really me. And also, no one can do me the way I can."

**HIGHLY ANTICIPATED BODY OF WORK FEATURES NEW SONGS “BLUE MOON,” “HOT & SEXY” AND MORE, PLUS ACCLAIMED SINGLES “PRETTY UGLY,” “CRUSH” AND “MIDNIGHT SUN”**

**NORTH AMERICAN HEADLINE TOUR SET FOR FEBRUARY – APRIL 2026**

![Image 2: ZARA LARSSON RELEASES NEW ALBUM MIDNIGHT SUN](https://cdn-p.smehost.net/sites/a6700d2fbaf642099802a57af8b10fe6/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Zara-Larsson-1.png)

**(Toronto, ON — September 26,2025)**It may be the first week of fall, but for**Zara Larsson,**summer never ends. Today, the multiplatinum chart-topping global pop powerhouse releases her hotly anticipated new album,**_Midnight Sun_**. Get it[**HERE**](https://eur01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fzaralarsson.lnk.to%2FMidnightSun&data=05%7C02%7Chansel.adukwarko%40sonymusic.com%7C06306560f3d64c6cbecf08ddfd163af7%7Cf0aff3b791a54aaeaf71c63e1dda2049%7C0%7C0%7C638944994151150296%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=HSa9NHAxeP0427kqzr%2FYD8UHzbpP4c8E5Fx9Z88XbBA%3D&reserved=0 "Original URL: https://zaralarsson.lnk.to/MidnightSun. Click or tap if you trust this link.")at all DSPs via**Sommer House**/**Epic Records**.

Unapologetically unfiltered and openly vulnerable, the 10-track set ripples with personal confidence and is set to a bold mix of kaleidoscopic pop and euphoric dance that complements**Zara**’s every mood. Plumbing the depths of her artistry and journey over nearly 20 years in the public eye, the album is unafraid to show all sides of the 27-year-old: lovestruck, wistful, ambitious, cocky, flippant, and uncertain, often in the same breath.

Also available today is the exclusive**_Midnight Sun (Lisa Frank Edition)_**CD, a vibrant collaboration with the iconic design brand**Lisa Frank, Inc**. The limited-run package brings to life a dreamy, aquatic world inspired by the memes and moments that so many of**Zara**’s fans around the world participated in over the past year.Get it while supplies last[**HERE**](https://eur01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fzaralarsson.lnk.to%2FLisaFrank&data=05%7C02%7Chansel.adukwarko%40sonymusic.com%7C06306560f3d64c6cbecf08ddfd163af7%7Cf0aff3b791a54aaeaf71c63e1dda2049%7C0%7C0%7C638944994151172884%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=KQn1sHFAHFQafqk0sR3evnXwR8F2UhiHaWD3AwWuBzo%3D&reserved=0 "Original URL: https://zaralarsson.lnk.to/LisaFrank. Click or tap if you trust this link.").

The album arrives as**Zara**approaches the finale of her arena-conquering run on**Tate McCrae**’s**Miss Possessive Tour**with back-to-back nights at**Los Angeles’ Kia Forum**starting tonight. As _Billboard_ proclaimed after a two-night run at**New York’s Madison Square Garden**, the tour has proven that**Zara’s**“_Stateside domination seems all but certain.”_ With that, she’ll headline her own**Midnight Sun Tour**starting in**Europe**this fall, with recently announced**North America**dates to follow starting in February 2026.See her global touring itinerary below go[**HERE**](https://eur01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.zaralarssonofficial.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7Chansel.adukwarko%40sonymusic.com%7C06306560f3d64c6cbecf08ddfd163af7%7Cf0aff3b791a54aaeaf71c63e1dda2049%7C0%7C0%7C638944994151189362%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=fu4PitMgjsRhRDIChzROEzLLt7UJcHtlGeTIZLVV4CU%3D&reserved=0 "Original URL: http://www.zaralarssonofficial.com/. Click or tap if you trust this link.")for tickets.

The headline tour will bring to life her most emotionally evocative and viscerally thrilling set of songs yet on**_Midnight Sun_**, which she crafted over the last year alongside songwriter**Helena Gao**and producers**MNEK**,**Margo XS**, and**Zhone.**

The previously unheard**“Blue Moon”**is an anthem for the hopeless romantics set to warm tones and heart-racing drum ’n’ bass rhythms — a celebration of timeless love. At the other end of the spectrum is**“Hot & Sexy,”**a mix of ’80s electro, ’90s house, Y2K pop, and 2010s bass music that samples**Tiffany Pollard**’s iconic _Big Brother_ rant – a charged-up “no boys allowed” anthem that evolves into a hyperpop fever dream with lyrics that dig deep beneath the surface and explore autonomy. On the introspective penultimate track “**Saturn’s Return**,”**Zara**reflects on personal growth and self-discovery, embracing uncertainty with a deeper sense of self. Paired with “**The Ambition**” right before, which explores the double-edged nature of drive and the pressures of success in modern times, the two highlight the album’s raw honesty as they explore identity, expectations, and stepping into a new era of life.

**_Midnight Sun_**’s robust set of new songs join already thriving singles like**“**[**Crush**](https://eur01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DZB600rRlPO8&data=05%7C02%7Chansel.adukwarko%40sonymusic.com%7C06306560f3d64c6cbecf08ddfd163af7%7Cf0aff3b791a54aaeaf71c63e1dda2049%7C0%7C0%7C638944994151204507%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=8Fvgy30ss6y7fUGbCiAR%2BKzqYWMXcIsRflNY5zBoge8%3D&reserved=0 "Original URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZB600rRlPO8. Click or tap if you trust this link.")**,”**which was one of the most-added at US Top 40 radio six weeks in a row, where it is currently Top 25 on the Mediabase Pop chart and pushing Top 10 on the Mediabase Dance Radio chart.The era kicked off with the unabashedly rowdy**“**[**Pretty Ugly**](https://eur01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DPaddtn5IdCk&data=05%7C02%7Chansel.adukwarko%40sonymusic.com%7C06306560f3d64c6cbecf08ddfd163af7%7Cf0aff3b791a54aaeaf71c63e1dda2049%7C0%7C0%7C638944994151219599%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=5gjYmmuwJY20Xahw1nH8PuC%2BC7mku%2F3BStYRSjcUGHM%3D&reserved=0 "Original URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Paddtn5IdCk. Click or tap if you trust this link.")**”**whose**Charlotte Rutherford**-directed,**Zoi Tatopoulos-**choreographed video was nominated at the 2025 MTV Video Music Awards for “Best Choreography.” And then there’s the transcendent title track,**“**[**Midnight Sun**](https://eur01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DuvY8fdgezLQ%26t%3D1s&data=05%7C02%7Chansel.adukwarko%40sonymusic.com%7C06306560f3d64c6cbecf08ddfd163af7%7Cf0aff3b791a54aaeaf71c63e1dda2049%7C0%7C0%7C638944994151234328%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=08w2oGZa%2Bo0nAujIMSfk1lSLfettwKYYYu%2BpYy3t36M%3D&reserved=0 "Original URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uvY8fdgezLQ&t=1s. Click or tap if you trust this link.")**,”**which has been viral all summer long thanks to**Charlotte Rutherford**’s Y2K-inspired music video and**Zara**’s jaw-dropping vocal prowess. With cosigns from a wide array of fellow artists like Renee Rapp, PinkPanthress and Ariana Grande, the press has rallied around the track, with _Rolling Stone_ calling it a _“song-of-the-summer contender”_ right out of the gate._PAPER dubbed it_ a _“shimmering pop anthem soaked in nostalgia,”_ while _GRAMMY.com_ wrote _“the beat drops with such hypnotic force that the track’s climax feels like staring directly into, well, a midnight sun.”_**_Pitchfork_**, however, summed up what we are all thinking: “_Midnight Sun is simply too much my shit!”_

_“Throughout Midnight Sun,”_**Zara****Larsson**says, “_I get to just capture that total Scandinavian vibe, which is something that I have grown up with—it’s a huge part of me, my happiest memories and my saddest ones, too. A part of my soul is a Swedish summer night. This record encompasses that.”_

Now, as the fires of anticipation reach a blinding blaze,**Zara Larsson**’s never-ending**_Midnight Sun_**is, at last, here — and here to stay.

_“It just feels like me—knowing myself, this album is just really, really me. And also,”_**Zara**says with a grin, “_No one can do me the way I can.”_

**About Zara Larsson**

On her fourth studio album,_Midnight Sun_, Swedish pop sensation Zara Larsson had a goal: “I wanted the whole album to feel like it’s a summer night and it never ends,” she says. “A part of my soul is a Swedish summer night. This record encompasses that, how life is so beautiful it makes you cry.” Once she put together her team of collaborators — “Never Forget You” collaborator MNEK, up-and-coming producer Margo XS, and songwriter Helena Gao — the core four got to work. On day one, they made lead singles “Midnight Sun” and lead single “Pretty Ugly,” realizing quickly that there was magic in the room. They felt an energy that connected them, emboldening her to be open, vulnerable, raw, and real.

_Midnight Sun_ ripples with that same confidence and trust. Its storytelling bursts with truth and vulnerability, plumbing the depth and growth of Zara’s artistry and journey over nearly 20 years in the public eye. It’s an album unafraid to show all sides of the 27-year-old: lovestruck, wistful, ambitious, cocky, flippant, and uncertain, often in the same breath._Midnight Sun_ follows Zara’s first three albums (2017’s _So Good_, 2021’s _Poster Girl_, and last year’s _VENUS_), building upon her legacy while taking things back to her roots. “Making this album brought me back to the very beginning, my first EPs when I started making music, because it was all about having fun and just creating and speaking honestly,” she says. “The people who will love this album will love a very true part of me.”

**Label:** Epic Records

Zara Larsson knows her way around a pop banger. ‘Lush Life’, ‘Never Forget You’, ‘Symphony’, ‘Can’t Tame Her’, ‘Ruin My Life’… the list goes on. The title track to fifth album, ‘Midnight Sun’, is easily up there with her most deliciously catchy, decadent pop anthems. A song about the eternal summer that happens in her home country of Sweden, it’s a joyful, upbeat track that you never want to end. Luckily, the shimmering ‘Blue Moon’ is just as jubilant.

The first two tracks to ‘Midnight Sun’ are pretty much exactly what we’ve come to expect from Zara, who’s built her career on pretty, polished, radio-friendly pop. However, album five sees her shake off everyone else’s idea of what a megastar should be and embrace her own smirking personality.

‘Pretty Ugly’ is a confidently chaotic, with Zara bringing a touch of punk rebellion and cheerleading energy to the electro clash, while the chirpy ‘Hot & Sexy’ is a ravey slice of ‘00s dance. It’s not just her influences, Zara is toying around with on ‘Midnight Sun’. The sleek ‘Girl’s Girl’ and the pulsating ‘Crush’ are hot, heavy and unafraid of the consequences before the stripped back ‘Saturn’s Return’ gets vulnerable about the uncomfortable growing pains that come in your late 20s. “It feels so good to know that I don’t know what I’m doing. I love that I’m free in my naivety,” she sings.

Then there’s ‘The Ambition’ which has Zara singing about wanting to sell out stadiums and top the charts while struggling with comparisons, needing validation and wanting to be understood. It’s a lot to get through in three-and-a-half minutes, but Zara makes fearless honesty look easy. The whole thing ends with the kiss-off romance of ‘Puss Puss’, the perfect conclusion to an album about really feeling herself.

_Midnight Sun_ is Swedish pop singer Zara Larsson’s fourth international studio album (fifth overall), released on September 26, 2025. It was released under her own record label, [Sommer House](https://genius.com/artists/Sommer-house). Commercially, the album [peaked](https://swedishcharts.com/showitem.asp?interpret=Zara+Larsson&titel=Midnight+Sun&cat=a) at #1 on the _Swedish Albums_ chart, #36 on the [_UK Albums_](https://www.officialcharts.com/charts/albums-chart/20251003/7502/) chart and #119 on the US [_Billboard 200_](https://www.billboard.com/artist/Zara-Larsson/chart-history/TLP) chart.

The lead single [“Pretty Ugly”](https://genius.com/Zara-larsson-pretty-ugly-lyrics) was released on April 25, 2025, with the second single, [“Midnight Sun”](https://genius.com/Zara-larsson-midnight-sun-lyrics), released on June 13, 2025. [“Crush”](https://genius.com/Zara-larsson-crush-lyrics) was released as the third single on August 15, 2025.

#### “Midnight Sun” Q&A

*   ### What did Zara Larrson say about the album? > I really am proud of my Swedish pop heritage, so I wanted to write about a Swedish summer where the sun never goes down. I wanted the whole album to feel like it’s a summer night and it never ends. And it doesn’t matter if it’s December: the summer night will be there for you. It’s waiting for you, it will come back for you, and you will come back for it.
> 
> 
> Throughout _Midnight Sun_, I get to just capture that total Scandinavian vibe, which is something that I have grown up with—it’s a huge part of me, my happiest memories and my saddest ones, too. A part of my soul is a Swedish summer night. This record encompasses that, how life is so beautiful it makes you cry. It just feels like me—knowing myself, this album is just really, really me. And also, no one can do me the way I can.

— [via _Dork_](https://readdork.com/news/zara-larsson-midnight-sun/) 
*   ### Is there an official animated artwork? Yes, [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/ua/album/midnight-sun/1817499239) features an [animated artwork](https://mvod.itunes.apple.com/itunes-assets/HLSVideo221/v4/a8/99/c6/a899c6fa-6c59-e053-b1bf-804256443126/P1177305280_Anull_video_gr598_sdr_2160x2160-.mp4) for this release.

2.title: How Zara Larsson Made Summer Last Forever With ‘Midnight Sun’
2.description: Nearly a decade after her hit “Lush Life,” Larsson delivers her most radiant body of work and explains how it all came together.
2.content:
[Skip to main content](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/zara-larsson-breaks-down-midnight-sun-summer-forever-1235437954/#pagetop)[](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/zara-larsson-breaks-down-midnight-sun-summer-forever-1235437954/)

How Zara Larsson Made Summer Last Forever With ‘Midnight Sun’
-------------------------------------------------------------

![Image 1: Zara Larsson](https://www.rollingstone.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/zara-larsson-interview.jpg?w=1581&h=1054&crop=1)

Zara Larsson Charlotte Rutherford*

The night [Zara Larsson](https://www.rollingstone.com/t/zara-larsson/)’s _[Midnight Sun](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-album-reviews/zara-larsson-midnight-sun-review-1235435727/)_ dropped, the singer’s closest friends, collaborators (and even a few Katseye members) packed into a Los Angeles bar to watch her blow out candles as the album officially arrived. The Swedish midnight sun she sings about wasn’t shining, but Larsson was.

“I feel like I rarely do that,” she tells _Rolling Stone_ the following morning. “I am so bad at celebrating milestones and accomplishments. I don’t even like celebrating my birthday. It was nice to come together in a room and remind ourselves that we made it.”

_Midnight Sun_ has reignited Larsson’s pop stardom in ways beyond even her own imagination. Nearly a decade after “Lush Life” and “Never Forget You” first launched her onto the global stage, the Swedish star is stepping into a new era. At 27, Larsson is reveling in long-overdue recognition — and finally basking in the spotlight her fans always knew she deserved.

A [_Rolling Stone_ review](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-album-reviews/zara-larsson-midnight-sun-review-1235435727/)of the album gave it four stars, lauding it for “refusing to ever slow down, instead trafficking in high-energy dance-pop joy.” Larsson admits to me that she read the review, and seeing the positive reception for the record has put a smile on her face — even if she isn’t allowing critical acclaim to dictate her happiness.

“I used to search my name on Twitter, and Google my name… This time, I, of course, want people to love it just as much as I do, but I am so proud of it. I’m really happy about this body of work,” she says. “I just have confidence in what we’ve created and how it feels for me, but it does feel great to have that sense of accomplishment validated.”

It’s been a long time coming. Pop stans will argue the rollout for _Midnight Sun_ — inspired by the endless summer evenings in her native Sweden — began more than a year ago, even if it wasn’t Larsson’s doing. Last summer, TikTok users revived her Clean Bandit collab “[Symphony](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-features/zara-larsson-dolphin-symphony-meme-clean-bandit-explained-1235098869/),” pairing it with surreal clips of dolphins flying through a Lisa Frank–like world. The posts were bizarre, but they put Larsson back in the pop conversation. And as she rolled out the new album, she leaned into that momentum, weaving it into a vibrant aesthetic defined by ultra-bright palettes and a Y2K-inspired, optimism-soaked style that matched the summery spirit of the project she’s made.

Editor’s picks
--------------

It’s been an impressive last year for Larsson, who spent the summer going viral for her performances and bubbly personality, reintroducing fans to a pop star fully in her element — giddy to deliver the full pop persona, no holds barred. She just wrapped an opening slot for [Tate McRae](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-album-reviews/tate-mcrae-so-close-to-what-review-1235275458/), where her choreography-packed performances shot through TikTok every night, and she’s gearing up for her own tour. First, she’ll fill arenas across Europe and then hit Jingle Ball in the U.S. before a massive 2026 run that promises to make the _Midnight Sun_ era burn longer and brighter.

Some of the songs on _Midnight Sun_ reflect an introspective side of Larsson, who goes from partying on “Pretty Ugly” and Crush” to speaking her truth about grappling with the ideas of success on “Saturn’s Return” and “The Ambition.” She says with a giggle: “It’s playful and fun, and also it has layers to it.”

From the back of an SUV in Los Angeles, Larsson breaks down five of her favorite tracks from the new album, describes how she got Tiffany Pollard to re-record one of her most viral memes, and explains why turning 27 might have changed her brain chemistry.

**Midnight Sun**
----------------

The title track sets the tone of the album. It’s melodic. It’s dance-y. It has this Jersey Club beat. I always wanted to write a song called “Midnight Sun.” I just loved the symbolism of it. I’ve tried it for five times and nothing really stuck. But, this time around, we fucking made it work. That was one of the first songs that we did for the project where it felt, “Oh, okay, this is definitely something.” And, on the same day, we did “Pretty Ugly,” so we were, like, “Huh, this is a fucking success. This is the energy right now. This is my album. This is what it’s going to be.” I’m just so happy about it and how it turned out. I finally have my perfect midnight sun song.

Related Content
---------------

**Eurosummer**
--------------

I like this being like a Eurovision song, like 2012 Romania or something. Do you remember “Mr. Saxobeat” by Alexandra Stan? Or “Hot” by INNA? It’s that Eastern European, almost Mediterranean vibe of just summer to me. The accordion, I just wanted to play with that because that to me is summer, and it’s nostalgic and it’s fun. I think that’s something that is just a part of who I am as a person and why I thought it was important to like, “How can I put my identity more into this album?” It’s camp. It’s fun. It’s silly, but so entertaining.I’m not going to be a part of Eurovision, but I can flirt with it. We take Eurovision so, so, so seriously. When people come over to Europe and have like a Eurosummer, it’s usually in the southern part of Europe, but it could also be in a tourist town in Croatia. It feels like me 10 shots in, me going to Turkey being 16. That’s also Eurosummer for me.

**Hot & Sexy**
--------------

“Hot & Sexy” is the bridge between “euphoric and fun” and “introspective” on the album because it’s about going out with your girlfriends, having a good time, being a bad bitch, looking good, and just being hot and sexy, feeling yourself, feeling, like, “Oh, yes.” And then we mashed that song with another song that we wrote earlier called “Let The Girl Live,” which is just about like, “Can a woman just live? Like, oh, my gosh, why do people have so many opinions? We want to be hot and sexy.”

The fact that Tiffany Pollard is on it is so iconic to me because she’s literally the internet. To me, she’s the ultimate queen of reality TV and giving you a read just effortlessly. I remember MNEK played me this track, and I was, like, “Oh, no, this is too good.” We just like hit her up and asked her if she wanted to come to the studio and just re-record it, And she was, like, “Yeah, I’ll come.” She was so cute and lovely. It’s not even a sample from Big Brother UK. It’s a re-recording of that iconic segment. She’s in the studio with her headphones and just, like, “Beautiful, fly, hot, sexy, thank you.” Ten minutes, in and out, we were, like, “Amazing.”

Trending Stories
----------------

**The Ambition**
----------------

I feel like I’ve always been super open and honest about, like, “I want to be a superstar. I want to have a big stage, and I want to have a big production.” And if it’s not happening now, then it will just happen later because I will keep releasing albums and songs and do what I love. In “The Ambition,” I’m like, “Will it ever really, truly be enough, or will my goalpost just keep changing?” I’m at a point where maybe the most important thing in my life isn’t to travel around and around and around and around. Maybe it’s about settling down, which is something I never thought of being a teenager. Like, “Wait. Maybe I want a family, and maybe I don’t want to just be on the road all the time. Maybe I want to have stability and settle down,” which is like kind of a scary thought because, if I’m not a pop star, then what is my purpose? I don’t know. And that’s Ok. Life changes. And, in a way, that’s the beautiful thing about it. It’s not supposed to be static. Sometimes you ask: “Life is so long. Am I a failure if I abandon my dream or if it becomes something else?” I feel like I know myself as a person a lot more now than when I was 20 or 17. I know more who I am. My roots are deeper, but then also that can maybe allow my leaves to change. To be clear: I think I’m going to be singing forever just because I just love to sing. That’s my passion, but there’s also so much more to life.

**Saturn’s Return**
-------------------

That one was the last song we made for the album. We were really supposed to finish. Margo, Helena, MNEK, and Zhone, we were just like, “Look, guys, we’re all here. Shouldn’t we just like make a song? Come on.” At that point, I was obsessed with the moon. I was reading about star signs and stuff, which I’m not really involved in, but, at that point, I was, like, “No. I feel something is shifting. I feel something is changing.” Saturn’s Return is when the planet goes back to where it was by the time you were born, which takes 27 years, and just how that’s a way of really coming into adulthood. I truly feel like I have changed a lot. Something in me has shifted just over the past year in how I move with everything in my life. It has made me very just humble towards life and how I’m just open to a lot of things, new perspectives, and see things from different sides. I think a part of it is like surrendering to life while also trying to do the best you can and be the best version of yourself. Life takes you on a journey and you can never really predict what it’s going to be. And I don’t know what it’s going to be, and that’s kind of nice.

Zara Larsson – Midnight Sun
===========================

Starry-eyed, joyous Scandi-pop...

[ClashMusic](https://www.clashmusic.com/author/clashclashmusic-com)

*   [Reviews](https://www.clashmusic.com/reviews/)

 26 · 09 · 2025 

It’s difficult not to interpret **Zara Larsson’s** fifth album as a course correction.

Arriving only a year after ‘Venus’,a record that saw the Swedish star caught between delivering a visionary pop opus and preserving commercial vitality,**‘**Midnight Sun’ feels like a return to form. Where its predecessor strained under that balancing act, this album offers no overarching concept or grand conceit, just wall-to-wall bursts of irresistible scandipop.

At just under 32 minutes, it’s Larsson’s shortest outing to date, and you immediately sense an artist trusting her instincts, fully uninhibited. Lead single **[‘Pretty Ugly’ is the prime example](https://www.clashmusic.com/reviews/zara-larssons-pretty-ugly-embraces-chaotic-energy/)**: its feisty gang-vocal hook is destined to spend its time lodged in listeners’ heads for much of 2025.The track brims with an air of unfettered abandon, a feverish rush of house piano stabs and maximalist production. ‘Midnight Sun’ is better still, where glittering hooks and club beats converge during its chorus to serve up something relentlessly euphoric and hypnotic.

—

![Image 5: A blonde woman sits behind the wheel of a car with pink upholstery and a jeweled steering wheel](https://www.clashmusic.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/unnamed-83-1.jpg)
—

Reuniting with longtime collaborator **MNEK****–**the British singer has production credits on each of the ten tracks here**–**has clearly reinvigorated Larsson, and her confidenceis palpable throughout. ‘Crush’ and ‘Eurosummer’ brilliantly fuse modern pop aesthetics and mass appeal with lean, astute writing, meanwhile reverberating walls of synthesizers bathe ‘Saturn’s Return’ in an opulent, hallucinogenic hue.

Ultimately, ‘Midnight Sun’ is Zara Larsson honing in on what she does best with laser focus: starry-eyed, joyous Scandi-pop built to ignite dancefloors as easily as festival sing-alongs.

**8/10**

Words: **Luke Winstanley**

_VENUS_ is Zara Larsson’s third international studio album (or fourth overall), currently set to be released on February 9, 2024. Larsson’s new album will also be doing so under her own record label Sommer Records, after gaining ownership of her musical catalogue from her former label TEN Music Group the previous year.

In January 2023, she personally stated that when working on her third album, she felt it was already “way better” than her previous album [_Poster Girl_](https://genius.com/albums/Zara-larsson/Poster-girl) and that is the way she wanted to evolve as an artist by constantly raising the bar for herself and her releases.

She also revealed that [Danja](https://genius.com/artists/Danja) and [Rick Nowels](https://genius.com/artists/Rick-nowels) became executive producers for the album and how Nowels introduced her to a new work ethic when recording material for it. She said:

> I’ve been in sessions with like nine people in the room, and I’m like, “What the f**k?” Here, it’s about telling a story.

Larsson announced the album on 26 October 2023. It includes the singles “Can’t Tame Her,” “End of Time” and “On My Love”. The album’s release is set to be accompanied by a UK and European headline tour, the Venus Tour, in February and March 2024.

Zara Larsson – Midnight Sun
===========================

[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.euphoriazine.com%2Fblog%2F2025%2F09%2Fmusic%2Falbums-zara-larsson-midnight-sun-review%2F)[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?via=euphoriazine&text=Zara%20Larsson%20%E2%80%93%20Midnight%20Sun%C2%A0%20-%20https%3A%2F%2Fwww.euphoriazine.com%2Fblog%2F2025%2F09%2Fmusic%2Falbums-zara-larsson-midnight-sun-review%2F)[](https://www.pinterest.com/pin/create/button/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.euphoriazine.com%2Fblog%2F2025%2F09%2Fmusic%2Falbums-zara-larsson-midnight-sun-review%2F&media=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.euphoriazine.com%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2025%2F09%2Fzara-larsson-785x523.webp&description=Zara%20Larsson%20%E2%80%93%20Midnight%20Sun%C2%A0)[](mailto:?body=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.euphoriazine.com%2Fblog%2F2025%2F09%2Fmusic%2Falbums-zara-larsson-midnight-sun-review%2F)

4.5

[Zara Larsson’s](https://www.euphoriazine.com/blog/2020/11/covers-zara-larsson/) latest album _Midnight Sun_ is the ultimate party record we didn’t know we needed. It comes packed with enough energy and zest across its 10 tracks as to make you put on your dancing shoes anytime, anywhere. From the get-go, Larsson proved that she was standing on business with the release of [“Pretty Ugly.”](https://www.euphoriazine.com/blog/2025/04/music/tracks-zara-larsson-pretty-ugly/) The electro-influenced lead single features a feisty, anthemic energy. It sees the Swedish singer-songwriter successfully paint female rage as a glorious force of nature. The accompanying music video somehow served to give us a taste of the sexy, fun, and high-energy imbued in the songs to come.

Following it up with the album’s title track, [“Midnight Sun”](https://www.euphoriazine.com/blog/2025/06/music/tracks-zara-larsson-midnight-sun/) really seemed like a natural progression to me. First, we got the anthemic one and its catchy chants of “_Have you ever seen a pretty girl get ugly like this,”_ so yeah, it’s possible she thought to wow us with her vocal serves in “Midnight Sun.” There’s something about hearing her sing “_a never-ending midnight sun”_ that reminds one that she sorta started her music career in a singing competition.

Prior to the album release, she’d already clued us in on the fact that this record is going to be about happy things with the color palette she chose to use for the visuals. Let’s just say she didn’t skip any bright colors, not even lime. “Blue Moon” is another happy-go-lucky track, with Larsson celebrating her beautiful “_kiss me in the dark_” romance. “_Shine on me, kiss me in the dark / Tell me I look beautiful underneath the stars / Head on your chest, that’s my favorite part / Don’t we look beautiful underneath the stars?”_ she sings.

In “Girl’s Girl,” she sings about the conflicting emotions that stir when you have a crush on a guy who already has a girl. This gets a bit more complicated when we learn that Larsson has known this “girl” from a tender age. Does she pounce, or play a girl’s girl? She gnaws over this in the chorus: _“I wanna be a girl’s girl / But what happens when a girl’s girl wants the boy? / I know that she’s my friend, but I just can’t avoid / The way I feel about you, if I have a choice / You’d be all minе.”_

Larsson was very hands-on with this project, working closely with her longtime collaborator MNEK and songwriter Helena Gao to bring the album to life. I wouldn’t go as far as to say that it was experimental, but she did bring in diverse sounds ranging from trance, Brazilian funk, to ballroom in an attempt to capture her confidence, youthful energy, growth, and ambition across the ten tracks.

In “Ambition,” she tells us of her supersized ambitions and how she “_wanna be lo-lo-loved.”_ Every song on this album is no doubt an experience that Larsson has lived. These experiences are brought to life with catchy hooks and brilliant pop elements – MNEK!!! – that serve to complement, rather than strip them of their authenticity and relatability.

### [Skye Newman – Lonely Girl](https://www.euphoriazine.com/blog/2025/12/music/tracks-skye-newman-lonely-girl/)

“This record has made me more expressive with my thoughts. It has definitely made me a better song writer, collaborator, clearer communicator and just over all a jolly person since it was such a smooth and heellaaa fun time to make it. It’s exciting to feel like this is only the beginning. This is just the very start of a great adventure into the creative unknown where the sun never stops shining! And that’s a journey I have not started on my own,” she shared with fans.

I’m on the side of fans who believe that it’s high time Larsson became a household name, because this album is one serve after another.

Blending heartfelt lyricism with a Baltimore club-inspired beat, the song captures the duality of vulnerability and celebration. The title itself references something rare and extraordinary—like a once-in-a-lifetime love—while the production keeps the track firmly on the dancefloor, balancing emotional depth with euphoric energy. Within the narrative of Midnight Sun, “Blue Moon” mirrors the album’s themes of identity, ambition, and fleeting moments of clarity under the endless Nordic summer light. The track has been praised for its vibrant rhythm and its ability to translate intimacy into a communal, high-energy sound. Interestingly, Larsson revealed in interviews that “Blue Moon” was one of the last songs completed for the record, and it quickly became a personal favorite for Zara because it perfectly tied together the album’s mix of nostalgia and forward-looking ambition. I think it allowed me to explore feelings I’ve had previously or things that I have gone through. the _title track_ can be interpreted as a “simple” love song, but as Zara has said it herself, is more of a song for the love of life. It was announced through her [social media](https://www.instagram.com/p/DKhMXPzNBAh/) on June 5, along with the release date of the album. In an interview with _BBC_, Larsson teased [the music video](https://x.com/zaralarssonBR/status/1934598386918862905), but with no release date yet +7 Share Q&A --- Find answers to frequently asked questions about the song and explore its deeper meaning Ask a question What did Zara Larsson say about "Midnight Sun"? Genius Answer 1 contributor > I love ‘Midnight Sun’. I love the title, I love what it’s saying. It sounds like a love song but really it’s a song for the love of life. It’s very me in my country house in Sweden, enjoying a Swedish summer night where the sun never sets, and that’s literally what it is. Life all night. It’s a very special thing that not a lot of people get to have as their childhood, but for me it feels nostalgic and something that’s true to what I feel like is home and personal. This song describes peak life for me, bringing out all my friends, driving in my car, listening to music, jumping in the water. It’s a celebration of life and I just want it to never end. —via [PAPER Magazine](https://www.papermag.com/zara-larson-midnight-sun) +26 Official Lyric Video Genius Answer 1 contributor +25 Behind The Scenes Genius Answer 1 contributor +20 Is there a live performance of "Midnight Sun" by Zara Larsson? Released April 25, 2025, the track was produced by MNEK, whom she worked with on her Top 10 hits “Never Forget You” and “Ain’t My Fault” back in 2015 and 2016. The song is a thumping, dirty electronic track with a 1990s house-inspired keyboard line and a shouting, chanting chorus that instantly commands attention. Lyrically, Larsson shreds the societal pressures for women to remain composed and “ladylike” and embraces her more chaotic and authentic self. Expand +5 1 Share Q&A --- Find answers to frequently asked questions about the song and explore its deeper meaning Ask a question What did Zara Larsson say about "Pretty Ugly"? Genius Answer 1 contributor > One fun fact about my new single, ‘Pretty Ugly,’ is that it’s the first song that we wrote for the whole album and we just knew, ‘There we go, yeah’. If I had to describe ‘Pretty Ugly’ in three words it would be: attitude, chaotic, loud. We did the single artwork when we were shooting the video and we were all muddy and messy and it was just a a little click of the moment which I feel like represents the song so well, also it’s in the same kind of world that we’re in for the video, yeah, and the inspiration for the video was just messy and dirty. —via [iHeart Radio](https://youtu.be/-L0Unsngo3I) +18 What did Zara Larsson say about the "Pretty Ugly" music video? Genius Answer 1 contributor > Some fun unexpected moments were when we did the video we did think the rain was going to be warm. The rain was very, very cold so it wasn’t fun but it was definitely unexpected. A fun one, they had this really cute, oh, this isn’t fun either, I was really sick and they had a oxygen tank but it was pink and it matched the pink car that I had to breathe into ‘cause Mexico City is high up. A fun one, I actually loved to do the VFX thing so in the beginning I’m being like pulled back by the the sound system but really in real life it’s a thread, that was really fun, and also when I’m being thrown up in the air by my friends, the cheerleaders, and then they drop me, that was also by like a threat that they just pulled me up in, and that was very fun. —via [iHeart Radio](https://youtu.be/-L0Unsngo3I) +15 Is there a live performance of "Pretty Ugly" by Zara Larsson? About
=====

This song bio is unreviewed

Song Bio 1 contributor

“Crush” arrives as the third official preview of Larsson’s fifth album, Midnight Sun, following the energetic “Pretty Ugly” (lead single) and the titular, dreamy “Midnight Sun”

In this tightly-wound pop gem, Zara navigates the treacherous thrill of a new infatuation while already in a committed relationship. She deals with temptation and the guilt of cherishing a “fantasy” that threatens her real-life connection.

What did Zara Larsson say about "Crush"?

Genius Answer

1 contributor

> ‘Crush’ is super fun because I would say she’s like the pop the pop girl of the album, you know, like really bringing that fun, upbeat, like tempo pop back. It’s a lot of energy. It’s a lot of um passion. I think it’s it sounds like fun and cute, but then you’re basically like I guess emotionally cheating. […] ‘Crush’ just felt like a really strong song to have to really get the party going. Keep it exciting. Keeps everyone, the attention, I think it’s a song that sounds amazing on radio. So that’s like a perfect radio song, a perfect pop song for me. And then we’ll just continue the journey. Honestly, I want every single song to have its moment. It is really hard to pick out like what to focus on for the moment. Like what’s going to be the single? What will we choose? Because I love them all so much. But I feel like ‘Crush’ has really big potential to um go far and you know spread spread her wings and really fly. Um, so hopefully people will listen to it and discover more of my stuff and also tap into the album.

—via [B96 Chicago](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q5yPwi7WKos)

This song bio is unreviewed

Song Bio 1 contributor

This track is a carefree, flirty track where Zara celebrates the thrill of a European summer fling with late nights, beach parties, and the kinda hazy memories that only happen on vacation.

What did Zara Larsson say about "Eurosummer"?

Genius Answer

1 contributor

> We were super inspired by the throwbacks of when I grew up. Romanian songs were peaking here in Europe. All the the INNA songs, Alexandra Stan – ‘Mr. Saxobeat’, songs with accordions…but it also was a nod to Eurovision. We were just talking about how a little fling could be like a Euro Summer. You know, you go down to South of France or Italy or Croatia and it’s lovely, but it only lasts for like, two months. So to compare that with a little fling.

—via [Capital FM](https://www.capitalfm.com/news/music/zara-larsson-midnight-sun-lyrics-meaning-interview/)

Song Bio 1 contributor

“The Ambition” is one of the most introspective tracks on Zara Larsson’s Midnight Sun (2025), diving into the double-edged nature of ambition. Over polished pop production, Larsson reflects on how the relentless pursuit of success can both inspire and drain, capturing the pressure of constant comparisons and the weight of never feeling “enough.” The track balances raw honesty with soaring melodies, making it both a vulnerable confession and an empowering anthem.

Within the album’s broader themes of identity and self-discovery, “The Ambition” stands out as a manifesto of Larsson’s personal and artistic growth. It explores her own struggle between chasing validation and reclaiming joy, showing the cost of ambition while refusing to let go of its fire. Interestingly, Zara revealed that writing this song felt like therapy, as it was the first time she admitted on record how ambition had shaped—and sometimes distorted—her happiness.

With a sleek, dance-ready beat and sharp pop hooks, the track blends confidence and sensuality, showing Larsson at her most bold and carefree. The Swedish phrase “puss puss,” which translates to “kiss kiss,” adds a personal touch that nods to her roots while keeping the song universal in its allure. Within the album’s narrative, “Puss Puss” contrasts the heavier, introspective moments with lighthearted empowerment. It embodies Larsson’s knack for balancing depth with pure pop fun, serving as both a wink to her audience and a celebration of self-assurance. About ===== This song bio is unreviewed Song Bio 1 contributor “Saturn’s Return” is a centerpiece of Zara Larsson’s Midnight Sun (2025), channeling the astrological concept of Saturn’s return—the turbulent life transition that typically occurs in one’s late twenties. Through shimmering synths and a spacious pop production, Larsson reflects on change, uncertainty, and the pressure of stepping into full adulthood. The track is both cosmic and deeply personal, turning a planetary cycle into a metaphor for growth, responsibility, and self-confrontation. As part of Midnight Sun, the song deepens the album’s exploration of identity and transformation. “Saturn’s Return” resonates as a moment of reflection amid the record’s more explosive tracks, allowing space for vulnerability and maturity. A curious detail is that Larsson has openly embraced astrology as a playful lens for self-discovery, and she revealed that this song was directly inspired by her own approaching Saturn return, making it one of the most autobiographical pieces on the album. You deserve an explanation, so please don't skip this 1-minute read. It's Sunday, December 21. Fewer people are seeing our message this month so it's harder than ever to hit our goal. If you've lost count of how many times you've visited Wikipedia this year, we hope that means it's given you at least $2.75 of knowledge. If everyone who finds Wikipedia useful gave $2.75, we'd hit our goal in a few hours.

It's been 25 years and Wikipedia is still free. It's still created by people, not machines, and we don't run ads or put up paywalls because we're not here to make a profit off your attention. In other words, it's still the internet we were promised.

Less than 2% of our readers donate, so if you have given in the past and Wikipedia still provides you with $2.75 worth of knowledge, donate today. If you are undecided, remember any contribution helps.

25 years of the internet at its **best**

How would you like to be reminded?

Whether you give now or later, any contribution helps. We can send you an email or text message reminder to join the 2% of readers who donate.

Thank you for donating recently!

Your support means the world to us. We'll hide banners in this browser for the rest of our campaign.

Want to show off your support? **Donors get 20% off Wikipedia Store merchandise automatically applied at checkout.** Click the button below to shop hats, tees, and more!

Other ways to give

[More ways to give](https://wikimediafoundation.org/give/#ways-to-give)
Where your donation goes

Accountability and transparency are core values at the Wikimedia Foundation. We manage funds and resources to ensure that every contribution supports our mission. We have earned the Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid (formerly GuideStar), and Charity Navigator awarded us its highest rating. You can [read our most recent annual report](https://annual.wikimedia.org/) for more information about our financial health.

45% Investment in Technology 
Nearly half of our budget goes toward supporting the technology that powers Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects. We are constantly working to enhance the user experience for both contributors and readers, improve site security, and ensure reliable access to our websites globally. This infrastructure and product support sustain one of the top ten most visited websites in the world, all at a fraction of the cost of popular for-profit websites.

34% Support for Volunteers 
The global reach of Wikimedia projects is made possible by the hard work of volunteers from across the globe. We provide grants, legal support, and other resources to help build vibrant volunteer communities. Additionally, we promote community engagement through outreach initiatives and advocate for the growth and protection of free knowledge.

12% General and Administrative Expenses 
Operational costs are essential for the smooth management and governance of the Wikimedia Foundation. These expenses help us recruit top talent and support staff around the world, empowering them to carry out the mission of the Wikimedia Foundation.

11% Allocation to Fundraising Efforts 
Donor support is crucial to sustaining Wikipedia and our other free knowledge endeavors. Our team is committed to efficient and effective fundraising throughout the year, ensuring that every contribution helps advance our mission.

The **Midnight Sun Tour** is the ongoing fifth [concert tour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concert_tour "Concert tour") held by Swedish singer-songwriter [Zara Larsson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zara_Larsson "Zara Larsson"), in support of her fifth studio album, _[Midnight Sun](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Midnight\_Sun\_(Zara\_Larsson\_album) "Midnight Sun (Zara Larsson album)")_ (2025). The tour began on 28 October 2025 in [Munich](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Munich "Munich"), [Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Germany "Germany") and will finish on 12 April 2026 in [Houston](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Houston "Houston"), [Texas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas "Texas").

On 5 June 2025, Larsson announced the tour, with seventeen shows across Europe scheduled to run from October 2025 through April 2026. Tickets went on sale eight days later, with an artist pre-sale which ran for two days prior to the general sale dates.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Midnight_Sun_Tour#cite_note-Dork_1-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Midnight_Sun_Tour#cite_note-Joe_1-2) The tour serves as a promotion for her fifth studio album, _Midnight Sun_.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Midnight_Sun_Tour#cite_note-Stereoboard_1-3) The tour will be held in several [arenas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arena "Arena"), making it Larsson's biggest headlining tour to date.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Midnight_Sun_Tour#cite_note-National_World_1-4)

On 2 September 2025, Larsson announced North American dates with Amelia Moore serving as the opening act. Presale tickets went on sale from September 3, with the general sale starting on September 5.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Midnight_Sun_Tour#cite_note-Rolling_Stone_1-5) On 4 September 2025, [Omar Rudberg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Omar_Rudberg "Omar Rudberg") was announced as the opener for the European leg.

Zara Larsson Is Ready to Shine on Her Own With 2026 ‘Midnight Sun’ Tour
=======================================================================

Singer has gone viral time and again for her stellar performances opening for Tate McRae

By [Tomás Mier](https://www.rollingstone.com/author/tomas-mier/)

### [Tomás Mier](https://www.rollingstone.com/author/tomas-mier/)

[Contact Tomás Mier on X](https://twitter.com/Tomas_Mier "X Icon")

September 2, 2025

![Image 2: Zara Larsson](https://www.rollingstone.com/wp-content/themes/vip/pmc-rollingstone-2022/assets/public/lazyload-fallback.gif)

Larsson Charlotte Rutherford\*

After a successful run [opening for Tate McRae](https://www.rollingstone.com/product-recommendations/lifestyle/how-to-buy-tate-mcrae-tour-tickets-online-2025-1235249323/), [Zara Larsson](https://www.rollingstone.com/t/zara-larsson/) is more than ready for her own headlining tour. _Rolling Stone_ can exclusively announce on Tuesday that the Swedish pop star will bring her _Midnight Sun_ tour to the United States in early 2026.

Larsson — who is set to drop her album _Midnight Sun_ on Sept. 26 — will kick off her extensive run in Portland, Oregon, on Feb. 28, before stopping in cities such as Los Angeles, Salt Lake City, Denver, New York City, Boston, Austin, and Houston. Amelia Moore will join her as an opener at all of the shows.

“Performing is my number one passion in life and I have never had this many stops on a tour of mine before, so the fact that I get to continue the _Midnight Sun_ journey and bring this amazing show to so many cities around America is truly a dream come true,” Larsson tells _Rolling Stone_. “With band, dancers, production, outfits and all the energy, this will be something special!”

> Having too much fun, so I’m coming back!! 💖 US headlining tour next year.  
>   
> Sign up here [https://t.co/z43wnPlBHT](https://t.co/z43wnPlBHT) for access to pre-sale starting Sept 3rd at 10am local. General onsale begins Friday Sept 5 at 10am local  
>   
> See you soooon 😘✨ [pic.twitter.com/WqTybwrTKj](https://t.co/WqTybwrTKj)
> 
> — Zara Larsson (@zaralarsson) [September 2, 2025](https://twitter.com/zaralarsson/status/1962878202755404080?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

Tickets for Larsson’s solo tour will go on sale on Sept. 3 at 10 a.m. local time for her fans, before a Spotify presale on Sept 4, before the general onsale time of 10 a.m. local time on Sept. 5.

The [tour announcement](https://www.rollingstone.com/t/tour-announcement/) comes in anticipation of her album _Midnight Sun_. So far, she’s released a trio of singles: “[Midnight Sun,](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/zara-larsson-new-song-midnight-sun-album-1235363959/)” “Pretty Ugly,” and “Crush.”

“I’ve probably written five songs called ‘Midnight Sun,’” she [told _Rolling Stone_](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-features/zara-larsson-midnight-sun-interview-podcast-2025-album-1235364489/) earlier this summer of the LP. “I’m like, ‘I like that title. I really want it. Because it just reminds me of home. And also I think the more I travel and the older I get, I wanna be reminded of home and my roots and a Swedish summer night.”

It’ll be a busy rest of 2025 for Larsson. After closing her [opening run](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/tate-mcrae-new-album-so-close-to-what-tour-1235165827/) with McRae, she’ll go on the European leg of her headlining _Midnight Sun_ tour from Oct. 28 through late November. She’ll then open for OneRepublic in Australia in early February 2026.

35.title: Zara Larsson’s Midnight Sun Tour is coming to North America in 2026 » // MELODIC Magazine
35.description: Pop star Zara Larsson has unveiled her 2026 Midnight Sun Tour in North America. She will be kicking it off in Portland on February 28, before concluding in Houston on April 12. The "Lush Life" singer made the announcement this morning, leaving fans eager for her return. Larsson is currently on Tate Mcrae's Miss Possessive

Zara Larsson’s Midnight Sun Tour is coming to North America in 2026
===================================================================

[News](https://www.melodicmag.com/category/news/)[Tour Dates](https://www.melodicmag.com/category/news/tour-dates/)

By:[Gabi Cuevas](https://www.melodicmag.com/author/gabicuevas/)

Date:

September 2, 2025

[![Image 5: Zara Larsson lies on the grass for the promo poster of her 2026 Midnight Sun tour](https://www.melodicmag.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Gz2O7_LWQAAMSjT-500x625.jpeg)](https://www.melodicmag.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Gz2O7_LWQAAMSjT.jpeg)

Pop star [**Zara Larsson**](https://www.melodicmag.com/?s=Zara+larsson) has unveiled her 2026 Midnight Sun Tour in North America. She will be kicking it off in Portland on February 28, before concluding in Houston on April 12.

The “Lush Life” singer made the announcement this morning, leaving fans eager for her return. Larsson is currently on [Tate Mcrae](https://www.melodicmag.com/?s=Tate+mcrae)‘s [Miss Possessive Tour](https://www.melodicmag.com/news/tate-mcrae-adds-23-new-dates-to-the-miss-possessive-tour/) as her support act. After her time there concludes, she is set to begin her [Midnight Sun Tour](https://www.melodicmag.com/news/zara-larsson-announces-fifth-album-midnight-sun-and-fall-tour-dates/) overseas in Germany and finish in her home country of Sweden at the end of November. She will be bringing along [Amelia Moore](https://www.melodicmag.com/?s=Amelia+Moore+) as her opening act.

Artist pre-sale begins tomorrow, September 3 at 10am venue local time; sign up [here](https://laylo.com/zaralarsson/m/midnightsuntour2026) for access. General on-sale starts Friday, September 5 at 10am venue local time.

Zara Larsson’s upcoming studio album _Midnight Sun_ will be available on all streaming platforms on September 26. Pre-save it [here](https://forms.sonymusicfans.com/campaign/midnightsun-presave/).

### Midnight Sun Review by Neil Z. Yeung

The fifth set of breezy, comforting dance-pop from Zara Larsson, Midnight Sun is inspired by the "never-ending" solar phenomenon that occurs during the summers in her native Sweden. Just as the sun never sets, this party never stops, and youth remains eternal for as long as possible. Larsson's vocals are the main draw, which remains a strong echo of [Rihanna](https://www.allmusic.com/artist/rihanna-mn0000367188), while the production -- provided by longtime collaborator [MNEK](https://www.allmusic.com/artist/mnek-mn0002943184) as well as [Margo XS](https://www.allmusic.com/artist/margo-xs-mn0004652569), [Zhone](https://www.allmusic.com/artist/zhone-mn0004438506), and [Helena Gao](https://www.allmusic.com/artist/helena-gao-mn0004633824) -- leans toward the [Charli xcx](https://www.allmusic.com/artist/charli-xcx-mn0002688864)-[Caroline Polachek](https://www.allmusic.com/artist/caroline-polachek-mn0002595433) spectrum of contemporary pop. There's a bevy of catchy beats that skitter and rattle throughout the tight ten-song set, from the euphoric hyperpop of the title track to the playful raver "Puss Puss" (which means "kiss kiss" in Swedish). The pounding electroclash "Pretty Ugly" is a defiant empowerment statement and might be the loudest, most aggressive song in Larsson's catalog to date, pushing the "Hollaback Girl" cheerleader energy to the brink. "Hot & Sexy" keeps that confrontational, do-what-I-wanna spirit alive, injecting some ballroom and trap into the mix. R&B sensuality and a house heartbeat carry the fantasy-baiting "Girl's Girl," while the pulsing club anthem "Crush" and the funky, Latin-tinged "Eurosummer" offer hedonistic, youthful release. Aside from the beat-forward dancefloor fodder, Larsson takes the time to explore her own growth as a 27-year-old on the carefree yet introspective "Saturn's Return," which captures her musings on life as the glimmering production swells around her soaring, angelic vocals. Stripping away the party-loving attitude, that matured perspective returns as she reveals her aspirations on the heartfelt "The Ambition," which analyzes her experiences with the highs and lows of fame. This refreshing honesty and reflective insight might not be as exciting as the immediate pop bangers, but they help elevate Midnight Sun to something more refined and graceful. Short and sweet, this catalog highlight benefits from its length, offering just enough of what Larsson does best to have listeners craving more of this endless bliss.

### Album review

**Zara Larsson** - Midnight Sun
===============================

[**4-5 Stars**](https://diymag.com/reviews/rating/4-5 "View all reviews rated 4-5 stars")

Entirely sun-drenched, exuberantly formulated pop.
--------------------------------------------------

![Image 1: Zara Larsson - Midnight Sun](https://d94thh4m1x8qv.cloudfront.net/d/diy/Artists/Z/Zara-Larsson/_300x300_crop_center-center_60_line/CRUSHLOOK07_00031_HR-copy.jpg)

### **Reviewer:** [Otis Robinson](https://diymag.com/contributor/otis-robinson)

### **Released:** 26th September 2025

### **Label:** Sommer House / Epic

Over a decade since their first collaboration, [Zara Larsson](https://diymag.com/artist/zara-larsson) and MNEK are reunited, with the British multihyphenate anointed as co-creator of this fourth record from the Swedish star. Where 2015’s earworm ‘Never Forget You’ Frankenstein-ed Zara’s R&B-indebted vocal control with elaborate EDM, across ‘Midnight Sun’ the pair similarly forge a maximalist, electronic pop future. Its title track alone is gutsy and boundless. It’s comprehensive in its variations of electronica, dance, Scandi-pop and R&B, creating a colourful body of work. Its forward-thinking, lush alive-ness cements Zara as a largely-overlooked genre VIP; a Main Pop Girl that has tirelessly and thanklessly worked beyond the spotlight to pave the way for a more seamless rise for her dance-pop successors.

“Puss puss / ’97 on the number plate,” she spits on the post-pop Brazilian funk cut ‘Hot and Sexy’, capturing the record’s cocky and maximalist party-girl intention; later, ‘Eurosummer’ does precisely what it says on the tin; and lead single ‘Pretty Ugly’ tears apart Pussycat Dolls-esque hip hop beneath raw cheerleader-y aggression. It’s just as committed to her Scandi roots, too: “I wanted to write about a Swedish summer where the sun never goes down,” she has asserted in recent press material. Elsewhere, ‘The Ambition’ is a bubbly confessional on fame and love; the cutesy ‘Puss Puss’ comes backed by hyperpop synths; and the airy alt-pop of ‘Saturn’s Return’ stands out at the record’s middle as an intriguing step into something new entirely. Near non-stop, ‘Midnight Sun’ is entirely sun-drenched, exuberantly formulated pop that’s both scaffolded by MNEK’s nostalgic production style and the Scandi-pop-meets-dance future that Zara has readily paved.

Zara Larsson – Midnight Sun (Sommer House/Epic Records)

It’s been a decade since Zara Larsson’s _‘Lush Life’_ landed. Stick it on in any nightclub or at any wedding reception, and everybody be on their feet. Who knew that Auntie June was such a connoisseur of tropical house pop? Or is that what they call the punch these days? While the dads swap dad jokes, everyone else basks in the certainty that Larsson has released a banger that will last forever – pop’s holy grail.

Almost immediately after _‘Lush Life’_, Larsson featured on _‘Never Forget You’_ by **MNEK**, who collaborated with Joel Corry on _‘Head and Heart’_– an insanely catchy track that reached number one during the insanely catchy Covid pandemic. MNEK is part of the _Midnight Sun_ production team assembled by Larsson tasked with ensuring her fifth album “feels like it’s a summer night and it never ends.”

![Image 31: Zara Larsson 1](https://www.godisinthetvzine.co.uk/wp-content/webp-express/webp-images/uploads/2025/09/Zara-Larsson-1-1024x782.jpg.webp)

Album opener and title track _‘Midnight Sun’_ was included in _Pitchfork_’s _‘2025 Songs of the Summer’_ list. While it did not achieve a rating of 9.48 out of 10, it did merit the observation that “mixolydian arpeggios undergird the song’s second verse.” High praise indeed, if you know what this means. To this I would add that the plinky sounds at the start are cool, and I like the 90s pop diluted drum ‘n’ bass beats. A year after _‘Lush Life’_ came **The Chainsmokers**’ _‘Closer’_. The second track on _Midnight Sun_, _‘Blue Moon’_, begins with chords that sound so similar to those on the 2016 monster hit that it’s a genuine surprise that Larsson doesn’t reprise memories of Blink-182 and Boulder. However, it does contain blissful lyrics such as _“Shine on me / Kiss me in the dark / Tell me I look beautiful / Underneath the stars.”_

The chorus on lead single _‘Pretty Ugly’_ is essentially an update of **Gwen Stefani**’s _‘Hollaback Girl’_. Jaded 43-year-old music critics are not its target audience, though the Italian house piano on the verses is very welcome. _‘Girls Girls’_ begins with arpeggios, though at the time of writing it is unknown whether they are mixolydian. The organ bass and stick-on-the-rim beat will bring all the **Craig David** fans to the McDonald’s car park. The PR claim that _‘Crush’_ is “a bittersweet single destined to soundtrack endless crying-in-the-club moments” seems doubtful, given that it’s as devastatingly catchy as…_‘Lush Life’_.

If **Arthur Schopenhauer** wasn’t dead and did a collab with **Sigrid**, it might sound like _‘Saturn’s Return’_ – a roomy, soaring, **London Grammar**-like reflection on ageing and truth. _“And it feels so good to know I don’t know what I’m doing /And I love that I’m free in my naivety, I won’t lose it” –_ try singing those lyrics in a club without crying (inebriated or not). Before you do that, imagine Audrey Tautou in the film _Amelie,_ weaving her whimsical way through a Parisian market. She is providing philosophical and twee narration over an accordion riff. That riff is used on _‘Euro Summer’_, which is as transparent an attempt to replicate the ubiquity of **Edward Maya & Vika Jigulina**’s _‘Stereo Love’_ as you will find.

_‘Hot and Sexy’_ begins with early-90s rave chord stabs and makes **Beyoncé**seem as sassy as a bunch of soggy daffodils on a grave. _‘The Ambition’_ is a frank admission of unsatiated ego (_“consumed by aspiration / numbers meaning more than words_”) and a pleading reminder that Larsson is a mere mortal too (_“I wanna be lo-lo-loved”_)_._ Predictably, _‘Puss Puss’_ is not a summons to a cat. _“Down Hollywood Boulevard, oh, boy, I’m a star,”_ she sings, though even stars need company, and her carnal impulses bring her back down to earth, where all the dancing and unspeakable things happen. In a fair world, Larsson would be as big as Taylor Swift or Jupiter. But, as a German with a large moustache once said: “Größe ist nicht alles.”

**Midnight Sun _is out now on Sommer House / [Epic Records](https://www.epicrecords.com/)_**

8

Zara Larsson Burns Through Sleepless Summer Nights on ‘Midnight Sun’
====================================================================

Swedish pop artist's high-energy fifth album mixes joy and confusion

By [Brittany Spanos](https://www.rollingstone.com/author/brittany-spanos/)

### [Brittany Spanos](https://www.rollingstone.com/author/brittany-spanos/)

[Contact Brittany Spanos on X](https://twitter.com/ohheybrittany "X Icon")

*   [Amanda Seyfried, Daniel Blumberg Duet on ‘Clothed by the Sun’ From ‘The Testament of Ann Lee’ Film](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/amanda-seyfried-daniel-blumberg-clothed-by-the-sun-song-1235476177/)

[View all posts by Brittany Spanos](https://www.rollingstone.com/author/brittany-spanos/)

 September 26, 2025 

![Image 23: Zara Larsson](https://www.rollingstone.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/zara-larsson-midnight-sun-review.jpg?w=1581&h=1054&crop=1)

Zara Larsson Charlotte Rutherford*

Euro summer isn’t over if you don’t want it to be. Just ask [Zara Larsson](https://www.rollingstone.com/t/zara-larsson/), whose fifth album, _Midnight Sun,_ keeps the good vibes, long days, and late nights going. From start to finish, Larsson’s latest refuses to ever slow down, instead trafficking in high-energy dance-pop joy.

Hailing from pop mecca Sweden, Larsson wanted to celebrate the sun-drenched energy of a summer in her home country. Title track “Midnight Sun” is as deliriously hypnotic as the experience of partying through 24 hours of daylight. With notes of trance in its swirling chorus uplifted by Larsson’s extended run, the song is the perfect high-energy kickoff to the rest of the LP.

As the album progresses, Larsson jumps between the more sweet and sour emotions that percolate in the heat. Like “Midnight Sun,” songs like “Blue Moon,” “Euro Summer,” and “Puss Puss” (Swedish for “kiss kiss”) traffic in the sweetness: she waxes poetic through tender scenes of short sundresses, late-night phone calls and handprints left on her ass. But the more interesting moments are when she’s a little naughtier. On “Girl’s Girl,” she’s wracked with guilt for wanting a childhood-friend’s man. Meanwhile, over the stomp beat of “Pretty Ugly,” she threatens slashed tires and crashed cars. “Have you ever seen a pretty girl get ugly like this?” she threatens early on the track.

But which is better? And where can you find them in stock? Presented By RS Recommends](https://www.rollingstone.com/product-recommendations/lifestyle/n95-vs-kn95-masks-1044184/)

The more complex, ugly feelings start to bleed into sleepless ruminations about her life. “The Ambition” pulls a few pages from the raw moments of Charli XCX’s _Brat_: Here Larsson yearns to be bigger, brighter. “But that’s the thing with the ambition/I want it so much/Everything’s a competition/So out of touch,” she declares on one of the biggest earworm moments of the project. “Saturn’s Return” is a standout in this vein, as the 27-year-old leans into life’s confusions, giving up control she sought when she was younger.

[![Image 25: A television shows two doctors looking at x-rays while two people watch from in front of the tv](https://polarcdn-terrax.com/image/v1.0.0/bin/606c86ef0ce74a0ca092ae66?v=96aff&h=300&w=430&autocrop=1) The Best Compact Sound Bars to Upgrade Your Home Theater System --------------------------------------------------------------- Upgrading from your TV speakers to a sound bar doesn't have to take up a lot of space. We review three of the best ones to pick up. Presented By RS Recommends](https://www.rollingstone.com/product-recommendations/electronics/best-compact-sound-bars-1012643/)

Those messier moments are where Larsson comes alive. You can hear her coming into her own across _Midnight Sun,_ where even her more formulaic moments still shine brighter than that Swedish summer sun. That ambition is paying off.

Zara Larsson: Midnight Sun
==========================

By [Jeffrey Davies](https://spectrumculture.com/author/jeffrey-davies/)

Posted on October 23, 2025

![Image 3](https://sp-ao.shortpixel.ai/client/to_webp,q_glossy,ret_img,w_1000,h_1000/https://spectrumculture.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/zara-larsson-midnight-sun.png)“_It’s been a while since I cried over something so nice_,” sings Zara Larsson on the title track to her fifth studio album _Midnight Sun_. The Swedish export has spent the better part of the last decade trying to break into North American pop to varying degrees of success. Where she found initial commercial fame on this side of the pond with her first international release _So Good_ in 2017, the ensuing years have seen her become more of a cult favorite akin to Carly Rae Jepsen or even Kylie Minogue. The only problem, one that shines brighter than the stars, is that Larsson’s penchant for EDM and Europop influences doesn’t always translate to a palatable sound.

Where _Midnight Sun_’s predecessor _Venus_ was a step forward in terms of dance-pop with vulnerability between the lines, Larsson’s fifth LP is a reversion to the commercial-friendly pleas of _So Good_ and _Poster Girl_. “_Have you ever seen a pretty girl get ugly like this?/ Messy like this?/ Losin’ her shit?_” she asks on the lead single “Pretty Ugly,” which seems to make promises for a body of work that details a pop star taking off her many masks. But _Midnight Sun_ is merely an attempt at a sultry summer pop album, released about two months too late, that misses every shot it takes.

For example, on “Girl’s Girl,” Larsson ponders the implication of a forbidden fruit, a lover that already belongs to a friend: “_I wanna be a girl’s girl/ But what happens when a girl’s girl wants a boy?/ I know that she’s my friend, but I just can’t avoid/ The way I feel about you_.” The track should work on paper as an excellent pop song, with all the inner workings of a seductress, a role Larsson plays well. However, the production sounds tired and overused. The same can be said for more raunchier offerings like “Hot & Sexy” or the appropriately titled “Puss Puss.” On the latter, Larsson gives in to every clichéd temptation: “_Feels like you’re touching me, touching me with your voice_.” It might work if not for the singer’s blasé efforts to also adopt an anti-Hollywood aesthetic throughout the track that suggests she’s better when leaning into her impulsive tendencies towards Europop. Unfortunately, she is not.

However, “Saturn’s Return” offers a too-late chance at redemption, poorly placed as the penultimate track. Its impact is ultimately lost when played after “The Ambition” and before “Puss Puss.” Over tropical house and dancehall influences, Larsson coos: “_And it feels so good to know I don’t know what I’m doing/ And I love that I’m free in my naivety, I won’t lose it_.” Although the track could have benefited from some tighter production, it’s the album’s only display of the vulnerability that Larsson’s catalogue desperately needs. Had the song been placed higher in the track listing, perhaps with an up-tempo beat, _Midnight Sun_ might have succeeded more as a complete body of work. Instead, it’s an afterthought, much like most of the singer’s pop songs. Despite her best efforts to play to both European and North American pop markets, Larsson continues to fall short. When she sings, “_Ain’t the concept of time so crazy/ We were just kids, now my friends are having babies_,” it seems to indicate the key to overcoming this flaw. Leaning into the naivety she refuses to lose on the next album may help.

Zara Larsson Earns Career Highs With 'Midnight Sun'
===================================================

* * *

 10-08-2025

* * *

![Image 9: Zara Larsson Earns Career Highs With 'Midnight Sun'](https://www.antimusic.com/news/photos/25/10/08/zara-larsson.jpg)

Play Zara Larsson 

 on Amazon Music Unlimited (ad)

(Epic) Zara Larsson's never-ending Midnight Sun is just getting started. With career-bests across the board, the multi-platinum global pop powerhouse celebrates several career highs.

Midnight Sun achieves a career-best debut at #3 on the Billboard Top Dance Albums chart, as well as in the top 25 of the Billboard Top Album Sales chart, landing at #22. She also lands #7 on Luminate's Current Pop Albums chart, #10 on Internet Albums, and is Top 20 on the Digital Albums chart.

"Crush," in addition, is currently Top 20 at radio on the Pop Published chart. Alongside Midnight Sun's momentum, Zara Larsson has reached several new milestones as she surpasses 10.5 billion streams. New certification from the RIAA across Zara's catalogue include 4x Platinum for "Never Forget You," 3x Platinum for "Lush Life" and Gold for "Wow," "I Would Like," "All The Time," and "I Can't Fall In Love Without You."

ZARA LARSSON
============

Who is Zara Larsson?
--------------------

Zara Larsson has always seemed to understand what it takes to be a pop star aiming for the big leagues. 2016 was her big breakout year, thanks to scintillating tracks like Lush Life, I Would Like and MNEK collab Never Forget You. Her debut album, So Good, followed in 2018, the year which also saw Zara claim her first Number 1 UK single on Symphony with Clean Bandit. Her sophomore record, Poster Girl, followed in 2021 after several delays. Her third album, Venus, arrived in 2024, heralded by the uber-pop banger Can't Tame Her, which hit the UK Top 40 in 2023.
